title: Carrots, radishes and other root crops
subcategory: Carrots, radishes and other root crops
summary: Produce straight usable roots in loose, stone-free soil with timely thinning.
steps: Prepare a deep loose surface without fresh clumps of manure or large stones.
Direct-sow evenly at the packet depth and keep the surface gently moist until emergence.
Thin without delay so roots do not compete; water afterwards to reduce disturbance.
Keep shoulders covered where the crop requires it and control weeds while small.
Harvest sample roots first and avoid leaving them until they become woody, split or pest-damaged.
